question: How can a support system reduce response time without increasing severe errors?
baseline: Generate an answer automatically and send uncertain cases to a human reviewer.

hard_constraints.text: Irreversible or legally sensitive actions must not be executed without human approval.
The system must provide a rollback or safe fallback for automated decisions.

success_tests.metric: median response time for reversible cases

success_tests.threshold: no higher than the human-review baseline
